patch_description: Split the shared RZ rotations into separate pre-entanglement (rz_pre) and post-entanglement (rz_post) parameters. Currently, both RZ layers before and after the CZ chain share the same parameter value, which constrains the optimizer. By allowing independent RZ rotations before and after entanglement, the optimizer gains more expressive power to learn layer-specific phase transformations. This sandwich structure (RY → RZ_pre → CZ → RZ_post) is a well-known quantum ansatz pattern that benefits from independent pre- and post-entanglement phase control. The parameter count increases modestly from 14 to 16 (only +2 parameters per block), which should have minimal impact on parameter efficiency while potentially improving convergence speed and generalization.
